steps.en: Install Letta Code, the maintained successor named in this repo's README
steps.zh: 安装 Letta Code，即本仓库 README 指向的现行实现

steps.en: Run it in your project and choose Letta Cloud or local state
steps.zh: 在项目目录里运行，选择状态放 Letta Cloud 还是本地

steps.en: Connect your own model keys and talk to the agent
steps.zh: 接上你自己的模型 key，然后和 agent 对话

steps.en: The agent rewrites memory blocks pinned in its own system prompt as it learns
steps.zh: agent 边学边改写钉在自己系统提示里的记忆块

steps.en: Every memory change is tracked in git, so it can be diffed or synced
steps.zh: 每次记忆改动都用 git 跟踪，可对比、可同步

steps.en: Next session, on any interface, the same agent resumes with its memory
steps.zh: 下次会话，无论从哪个入口进来，都是带着记忆的同一个 agent

value.en: One persistent agent that remembers you across sessions and devices, without you building a memory store
value.zh: 一个跨会话、跨设备记得你的持久 agent，不用你自己搭记忆存储
